items.html: And we have no more power to raise the six last [Sefirot] of Assiya into the world of Atzilut at any time at all. And in the Gate of the Mitzvot, in the commandment of the seventh [year], the reason for the descent of the worlds is explained — that it was to sort out the clarifications (Birurim) of the kings that descended there. And see there.
